notes.title: RHYTHM LIFE DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!!

If you like muisc and rhythm, try the demo and don't forget to follow us on  [url=https://twitter.com/Fountaingame101]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/C2bVEn5MXu]Discord[/url].. We are happy to particpate into this VR fest festival. 

Feel free to try the demo and don't forget to follow us on  [url=https://twitter.com/Fountaingame101]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/C2bVEn5MXu]Discord[/url].

WHAT'S NEXT FOR RHYTHM LIFE?
Rhythm life will continue development to improve the game with your feedback. The full version is planned to release in early 2024. Join the Discord if you haven't already to connect with other players. There you can give feedback, leave suggestions, and interact the development
